## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Lisbon, Portugal. It starts at Praça Marechal Humberto Delgado.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> The Lisbon Zoo is the oldest of its kind in the Iberian Peninsula, dating all the way back to 1884. Right in the heart of Lisbon, you can plan a day at the zoo and turn it into a one-day exploration of the entire planet!
>
> Travel the world, without leaving the comforts of Lisbon. Start by discovering the Sumatran tigers in the dense vegetation of the humid rainforest, observe the behavior of lions, giraffes and elephants as they roam the arid African savanna, and be dazzled by the majestic and colorful birds of South America.
>
> By visiting the zoo, you're also contributing to their mission to conserve some of these wonderful species and their habitats.

## Price and rating

On 13 November 2026, WeGoTrip's product data listed it from €37.18. It was rated 4.6 out of 5 from 365 ratings and 118 written reviews. The final price is shown at WeGoTrip's checkout.

## Where this page comes from

This page was built on 13 November 2026 from WeGoTrip's partner data, the product information WeGoTrip gives its affiliates. We have not taken this tour ourselves, so check the listing for anything that matters to you before you book.
